content: Room migration pitfalls: 1) Never use JSON blobs (TypeConverters) for nested objects (like Lesson -> Exercises) because migrating them later is a nightmare. Use proper relational tables and foreign keys. 2) Never mix @AutoMigration and manual migration in the same version step. 3) Room's fallbackToDestructiveMigration permanently deletes user data. 4) Always set exportSchema = true.
